tool.name: Proseg
tool.command:
ln -s '$transcripts' transcripts.csv && mkdir out_dir &&
proseg --output-path 'out_dir' --gene-column 'gene' --cell-id-column 'cell_id' --x-column 'x' --y-column 'y' --z-column 'z' --cell-id-unassigned '0' transcripts.csv &&
## 1. Create the directory Galaxy expects for extra files mkdir -p '$segmentation_results.files_path' &&
## 2. Copy the Zarr directory into that extra files path cp -r out_dir/proseg-output.zarr/* '$segmentation_results.files_path' &&
## 3. Create a simple log or summary as the 'main' file so Galaxy is happy echo "Segmentation complete. Results are in the Zarr directory." > '$segmentation_results'
tool.outputs: ## Change back to 'txt' or 'data' for the primary file
tool.help: Proseg 3.1.1. Results are stored as a Zarr hierarchy in the extra files path.
